title: Incident Investigation and Coordination
description: Receive reliability errors, correlate incident signals, perform basic evidence-backed RCA, establish impact and severity, and coordinate current status.
setup_prompt: Use Incident Investigation and Coordination with my service operations process. Configure authenticated alert/manual/Slack intake, severity and role policy, evidence sources, hypothesis and timeline management, status delivery, dashboard reporting, and remediation handoff.

setup_inputs.label: Services, environments, topology, ownership, and SLOs
Severity, roles, escalation, update, and closure policy
Alert, monitoring, log, trace, deployment, and incident sources
Webhook, manual, and Slack intake mappings
On-call targets, Slack routing, audiences, and restricted-data rules

recommended_tools.name: AgentWorks API trigger
recommended_tools.purpose: Start the saved incident route from authenticated monitoring or incident events

recommended_tools.name: Observability MCP or CLI
recommended_tools.purpose: Read scoped metrics, logs, traces, alerts, and service health

recommended_tools.name: AgentWorks Slack bot
recommended_tools.purpose: Coordinate one incident thread, questions, decisions, and status

recommended_tools.name: Incident-management MCP
recommended_tools.purpose: Read or update authorized incident records and on-call state

outputs: Basic RCA with evidence, confidence, and unknowns
